system.description:
At 3rd level you take the first steps to truly begin your noble path. With no land to your name, you set forth to earn the titles you will bear. You gain the benefit of the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.oqsv50k3glkbk7z2]{Find Steed} spell without casting it. You may set your steed to wander, safely, with a command, or call it back with a whistle, causing the steed to rush to your aid.

Should your steed perish, you must wait until the end of a long rest to find a new steed. Again, you gain the benefits of the spell without casting it.

In addition, your steed gains a maximum hit point increase equal to your level.
